title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools Specification
description: Formal contract definition for all MCP tools exposed to external AI agents.

tools.name: list_polish_used_price_products
tools.description: List product configurations (smartphones, laptops, RAM, cars) tracked for Polish marketplace fair price history.

tools.name: get_polish_used_price_history
tools.description: Get dated, manually reviewed Polish marketplace asking-price observations for one exact product slug.

tools.name: audit_website_seo
tools.description: Run a deterministic technical SEO audit for a public website URL.

tools.name: analyze_geo_readiness
tools.description: Analyze Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) signals and AI crawler readiness.

tools.name: calculate_polish_income_comparison
tools.description: Calculate Polish contract and tax net income comparison for a company budget.

tools.name: update_polish_used_price_observation
tools.description: Admin tool: Add or update a verified Polish used price observation for a product slug. Authorization is handled via the Authorization header.

tools.name: get_admin_dashboard_statistics
tools.description: Admin-only aggregate traffic, private submission, SEO audit and market coverage statistics. Traffic contains privacy-preserving page views, unique visitors, source categories, referring domains and top paths for the last 7 and 30 days. Requires Bearer authorization.

tools.name: list_admin_contact_leads
tools.description: Admin-only list of recent private consultation requests. Requires Bearer authorization.

tools.name: list_admin_product_requests
tools.description: Admin-only list of requested products for the price index. Requires Bearer authorization.

tools.name: list_admin_price_tips
tools.description: Admin-only list of active listing links awaiting manual price review. Requires Bearer authorization.

tools.name: list_admin_recent_audits
tools.description: Admin-only list of recent SEO audit runs with sanitized operational details. Requires Bearer authorization.

tools.name: inspect_domain_security
tools.description: Inspect domain email security and deliverability standards: DMARC (BIMI compliance), BIMI DNS & SVG reachability, MTA-STS (RFC 8461), SMTP TLS-RPT (RFC 8460), SPF and MX records.

tools.name: transpile_to_caddyfile
tools.description: Transpile Nginx (nginx.conf, server blocks) or Apache (.htaccess, VirtualHost) web server configuration to clean, idiomatic Caddyfile with migration advisories.

tools.name: inspect_apple_pkpass
tools.description: Inspect and validate Apple Wallet .pkpass JSON structure (pass.json) or package manifests: checks required keys, pass styles, dates, ISO 8601 timezones, transit types, barcodes, and color contrast.
